name: Haulmer Curico data center operations
notes: Job listings and company profile show Haulmer operating data center/hosting functions in Curico, with references to data center activity in Maule. Small enterprise/hosting facility; no hyperscale capacity found.

name: Google Quilicura data center
notes: Official Google site says the Quilicura data center went online in January 2015 and remains an active Google data center location.

name: Google Cerrillos Data Center
notes: US$200m Cerrillos project was paused/reworked after water-use litigation; latest searched report says Google revived the plan with air-cooling design. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Chile Central datacenter region
notes: Chile Central launched in the Santiago metropolitan region with three physically independent locations, each housing one or more data centers.

name: AWS Chile cloud region - Santiago province buildout
notes: AWS announced more than US$4bn over 15 years; InvestChile says the infrastructure investment is for three data centers located in the province of Santiago.

name: AWS SCL Huechuraba data center campus
notes: US$205m Huechuraba project with two data center buildings on 10.9 ha; environmental court approval reported after appeal dismissal. Capacity not disclosed.

name: AWS Padre Hurtado campus data center
notes: Baxtel reports first 4,630 sqm building online at an 18.7 ha Padre Hurtado site, with a second 3,470 sqm building scheduled for 2028. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Scala Lampa campus - SSCLLP
notes: Scala announced environmental license for its Lampa campus in Santiago metropolitan area, citing 120MW total capacity and initial 30MW delivery.

name: Equinix ST5 Santiago data center
notes: US$130m Pudahuel facility planned with 16 data rooms and 24,420 sqm; environmental approval reported in 2025, first phase expected April 2027.

name: Equinix Santiago IBX ST1-ST4
notes: Equinix says it operates four data centers in the Santiago metro. Facility pages cite combined colocation space of about 7,536 sqm and total capacity of 7.5MW.

name: Aligned/OData ST01 Lampa campus
notes: ST01 in northwest Santiago/Lampa offers about 28MW across 40,400 sqm; originally OData, now an Aligned Data Centers company.

name: Aligned/OData ST02 data center
notes: Official OData/Aligned announcement states ST02 offers up to 40.6MW IT load and about 366,000 sq ft.

name: Ascenty Santiago 1 data center
notes: Official Ascenty facility page lists Santiago 1 with 10MW site power capacity and 7,000 sqm gross data center space.

name: Ascenty Santiago 2 data center
notes: DCD reports Santiago 2 launched in August 2022 in Quilicura, covering 22,000 sqm with 16MW IT load.

name: Ascenty SCL03 Quilicura data center
notes: Ascenty inaugurated SCL03 in Quilicura with 16MW capacity and 8,000 sqm footprint; three Ascenty Chile data centers total 42MW.

name: TECfusions/Baeza Puente Alto data center campus
notes: 40-acre Puente Alto site planned to launch with 10MW immediately available plus 10MW from local grid and scale to 100MW, pending due diligence.

name: Data Center Alto Jahuel
notes: SEA pertinence file and local reporting identify Habilitacion Data Center Alto Jahuel in Buin by DC Terranova SPA; reported as exempted from SEIA with US$25m investment and 990 tonnes diesel storage. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Data Center Alto Jahuel Sur
notes: Local investigative reporting identifies a separate Alto Jahuel Sur data center consultation by GR Huina SPA, linked to Grenergy, with about US$20m projected investment. Capacity not individually disclosed.

name: Grenergy Polpaico data center
notes: Same local reporting says Grenergy plans data centers in Alto Jahuel, Polpaico, and Antofagasta; three projects reportedly sum to about 1,000MW, but individual Polpaico capacity was not confirmed.

name: Codelco El Teniente / Patio Rancagua main data center
notes: Official Codelco article says the corporation inaugurated its principal modern Tier 3 data center in Building 351 at Patio Rancagua, centralizing former divisional data centers.

name: ZOFRI Iquique data center
notes: Universidad de Tarapaca report documents student visit to the data center belonging to Zona Franca in Iquique. No capacity or current expansion details found.

name: Scala Curauma campus / SSCLCR01
notes: Scala announced the Curauma, Valparaiso campus with 30MW IT capacity; first SSCLCR01 site started with 5MW and was fully booked to a hyperscale customer. Earlier license material also referenced future campus scaling.

name: Tecnoera NetExplora data center - Vina del Mar
notes: Tecnoera/NetExplora public pages describe datacenter/cloud services and two world-class data centers in Chile; DataCenterMap lists NetExplora Data Center in Vina del Mar as Tier 3-referenced.

name: Centro Nacional de Supercomputo e Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada - Vina del Mar
notes: MinCiencia/CORFO and PUCV report a national AI supercomputing center to operate from Tecnoera's data center in Vina del Mar, with investment above US$9m. Included as HPC/data-center-adjacent infrastructure.

name: Telxius TSGO01 / Valparaiso cable landing data center
notes: Inflect lists Telxius Cable TSGO01 in Quilpue/Valparaiso; Telxius official material confirms Valparaiso landing infrastructure and CLS/data center services across its network. Treat as cable landing/edge infrastructure rather than hyperscale data center.
